name: io.github.teransarathchandra/jira-delivery-mcp
title: Jira Delivery
description: Jira Cloud delivery layer: ticket briefs, acceptance-criteria checks before the PR, QA handoff.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://your-domain.atlassian.net

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email of the Atlassian account the API token belongs to

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: true to register the write tools (comment, transition, assign, link); off by default
